office_does: The sheriff is Douglas County's elected chief law enforcement officer and runs the Sheriff's Office, which patrols and investigates across the county and coordinates emergency response.
race_blurb: Sheriff Kevin Morris retired in March and commissioners appointed Undersheriff Tyler Caille to finish the term. Caille, running on continuity with the backing of the three living former sheriffs, faces Chelan County Sheriff's Sgt. Adam Musgrove, a retired Navy senior chief running on change; Caille led the August primary 4,936 to 2,780.

candidates.summary: Appointed Douglas County Sheriff since March 2026 after seven years as undersheriff and about 20 years in the office; also fire chief of Douglas County Fire District 5 in Mansfield.
highlights: Appointed sheriff by the county commissioners effective March 1, 2026, to finish Kevin Morris's term [S5]
Lists focused enforcement on illegal drugs and gangs, countywide staffing and deployment, and keeping school resource officers [S3]
Pledges deputy wellness support and partnerships with crisis and behavioral-health professionals [S3]
Endorsed by former sheriffs Morris, Gjesdal and LaRoche and 22 Washington sheriffs [S4]
Led the August primary with 4,936 votes [S12]

experience.basis: Sitting appointed sheriff after seven years as undersheriff and nearly 20 years in the office, running on continuity.

safety.basis: Enforcement priorities on drugs and gangs and visible presence, paired with crisis and behavioral-health partnerships.

candidates.summary: Chelan County Sheriff's Office sergeant and former chief of patrol, a retired Navy senior chief, running for office for the first time on bringing change to the Douglas County Sheriff's Office.
highlights: Says he is 'not interested in maintaining the status quo' and wants 'meaningful change' [S1]
Backs 'Broken Windows' policing and 'zero-tolerance' for gang-type crime [S2]
Says mental health cannot be passed 'onto the hospital or the jail'; his campaign says he co-founded the Chelan County Behavioral Health Unit [S2][S3]
Says he 'will not enforce laws that infringe upon your rights' [S2]
Endorsed by the Douglas County Republican Central Committee (19-1) and Teamsters Local 760 [S4]

experience.basis: First-time candidate from another agency running explicitly against the status quo, though with 20 years in law enforcement.

safety.basis: Zero-tolerance gang enforcement and 'war on drugs' language, alongside a mental-health response he says keeps people out of jail.
